title: Cache-aside
hints: get_user: build the key f"user:{user_id}", try cache.get(key), and on a hit return json.loads(cached).
On a miss call db.load_user(user_id). Store a found user with cache.setex(key, 300, json.dumps(user)), and a missing one with cache.setex(key, 30, "null").
json.loads("null") is None, so a cached "not found" is returned as None without any special case.
update_user: db.save_user(user_id, fields) and then cache.delete(key).
